en: A black‑and‑white night photograph showing grand baroque and historicist buildings illuminated along a riverfront. Reflections of the lights shimmer in the calm water in the foreground. On the right stands a tall, ornate church tower with statues along the balustrade. On the left are large civic buildings with a clock and a domed tower. A long, low riverboat or paddle steamer with lit windows is moored along the quay.
